title: Waiver
summary: A waiver settles a requirement that still counts. Waiving a retracted, superseded or replaced row refuses with requirement_not_live and names the live copy of the same case to waive instead. A waiver may land while a live walk runs the case: the case still records its result beside the waiver and the walk continues, while the waiver governs the gate. The waiver commits in the request; settlement replay and member close-out follow from a durable queue that control-plane upkeep drains and retries, riding the API server's health refresh or a machine-local universe's relay cycle. A replay that keeps failing is listed in the steering report with its item and error.
